preconditions.description: The number of cities (n) and plans (q) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each city's mineral resource label (a_i) is between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(roads) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in roads)
preconditions.description: The roads form a tree with exactly (n-1) bidirectional edges between distinct cities.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= l_i <= r_i <= n for u_i, v_i, l_i, r_i in plans)
preconditions.description: Each plan's parameters (u_i, v_i, l_i, r_i) are within valid bounds.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly one line per query.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] == -1 or (l_i <= output_lines[i] <= r_i and sum(1 for city in path(u_i, v_i) if a[city] == output_lines[i]) % 2 == 1) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: For each query, the output is either -1 (no valid mineral) or a valid mineral c_i that appears an odd number of times on the path between u_i and v_i and lies within [l_i, r_i].
